messages.subject: mirtCAT GUI layout
parts:
I know with shiny `sidebarPanel()` takes position as an argument, so one can specify left or right. Is there similar functionality with mirtCAT?

What I've tried already is grabbing the `default_ui()` function from github (since it doesn't have its own help page), adding the position= 'right' argument, and feeding that back via `mirtCAT(..., ui=default_ui_right())` but it fails to find the .MCE object, which I don't want to get rid of given that its used elsewhere throughout.

Any suggestions?

Aaron

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: mirtCAT GUI layout
parts:
Quick and dirty way would be to follow what you proposed by forking the package on Github, replacing the code you want, then installing that version to replace mirtCAT (devtools::install_github('yourusername/mirtCAT')). There are other ways of going about this though, including defining your own manual GUI structure. See the GUI-tests file for some examples that might be helpful in this respect. 

Phil
